packet:80fdab87-7d1c-4bc6-b2b9-5a106e2da.title: Recommended Rerun pattern: log a right-handed Z-up world at `spear`, log camera extrinsics and intrinsics at `spear/camera`, use camera local axes `RDF` with a child-to-parent `Transform3D` whose `mat3x3` columns are the camera-local RDF basis vectors expressed in the Rerun world frame, and log all camera-captured RGB/depth/modal images under `spear/camera/...` so Rerun can attach them to the pinhole/frustum. Current `spear/images/depth_meters` placement is the main issue for 3D origin/backprojection. Primary references used: Rerun stable Python archetype docs for `Pinhole`, `Transform3D`, `Image`, `DepthImage`, and `ViewCoordinates` at https://ref.rerun.io/docs/python/stable/archetypes/ and https://ref.rerun.io/docs/python/stable/common/datatypes/, plus local rerun-sdk 0.32.2 installed under `/tmp/rerun-check.Ae1kiB`.
